card.name: Word starts in Spanish and Slovene text
card.fires_on: The first or middle piece of a longer word that is split up, mostly in Spanish, Slovene or other non-English names and terms. It is often a place name, plant name or drug name in a reference list.

modes.label: Spanish word pieces
modes.description: A split piece of a Spanish word or name, often right after a comma or a preposition.
modes.example: El Perú y Chile,<< p>>ese a las diferencias históricas

modes.label: Slovene and place names
modes.description: A middle piece of a Slovene title or place name in a bibliography.
modes.example: Savnik, Roman, ed. 1968. Krajev<<ni>> leksikon Slovenije, vol.

modes.label: Drug and plant names
modes.description: A split piece inside a drug, chemical or plant name in a list.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are a mixed set (arithmetic, add words); there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the early or middle chunk of a long foreign-language word or name that is split into pieces.
